description:
Every woman on Earth disappears at 9:41 p.m. Except you. You're the last woman on Earth, and you have 100 years to stop humanity from dying out.

From the morning after to a secret lab, this is what would really happen if you were the last girl alive.

▶ The other side: What If You Were the Last Man on Earth? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XbXiFizyGko

0:00 Every woman disappears
0:26 The Morning After
2:16 The Last Bachelorette
4:33 The Math
5:55 The Lab
7:29 The Last Woman

Hospitals lose 9 in 10 nurses. Schools close. Millions of dads learn to make a bottle at 3 a.m. Every man on Earth wants a date, so you go undercover as Steve, pick the bear over the man, and team up with Admiral Doug Hartley and Dr. Kenji Mori. Then comes the math: one womb, about 300 eggs, and a world that shrinks to a few thousand people in 100 years. Can lab-grown eggs, artificial wombs and IVF save the human race?

Last man or last woman: which would you rather be? Tell us in the comments.

If you're struggling, call or text 988 (US) or find a helpline at findahelpline.com.

Our Sources:
- Share of nurses who are women: WHO, State of the World's Nursing 2020
- Male suicide rates: WHO global suicide estimates
- Most children born to one mother (69): Guinness World Records
- Eggs from male mice: Hayashi lab, Nature (2023)
- Human eggs made from skin cells: OHSU, Nature Communications (2025)
- Premature lambs in an artificial womb: CHOP, Nature Communications (2017)
- Mitochondrial Eve: Cann, Stoneking and Wilson, Nature (1987)
